name: webpage-to-markdown-local
title: Webpage to Markdown (Local)
description: Convert a webpage to Markdown locally, without using a cloud conversion service.
author: mikeoertli

commands.name: webpage-to-markdown-local
commands.title: Webpage to Markdown (Local)
commands.subtitle: Convert a webpage to Markdown locally
commands.description: Downloads a webpage directly and converts it to Markdown on your computer, without a cloud conversion service.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
